limits: Phone-screen recordings; not native camera frames. No physical accuracy percentage or final thresholds inferred.
scope_update: User emphasizes threshold/recipe tuning from labeled samples as primary action; resolution and existing method retained; no source generation before confirmation.

observations.wait_meaning: Missing eligible result at the photographed frame is a failure observation, not a sample-validity gate. Visible bodies/holes remain independent ground-truth evidence for threshold tuning.
observations.empty_cards_on_abnormal_scenes: Selected boxes generally surround small neighboring empty openings; photos do not prove the large standing/flipped body itself was boxed and assigned EMPTY.
observations.calibration_limits: Many probes fall on black tape or clip objects. WAIT/CLIP records and screen-photo pixel brightness cannot supply final body/hole thresholds. Same frame can label large/small holes, but a fixed single probe cannot measure both simultaneously.
observations.video1: 14.23s. 16 evenly spaced extracted frames reviewed; both top PRESENT and lower EMPTY observed. FILL/REF review flags change between sampled frames. No claim of exhaustive per-frame stability.
observations.video2: 21.76s. 16 evenly spaced extracted frames reviewed. Around2.04s top UNKNOWN/UNCERTAIN; around4.76..10.20s top bodies are at/outside the effective-region right edge and NO TARGET appears; after11.56s selected PRESENT returns. Selected objects may differ. Global MEAN samples fixed central area rather than each body.
observations.lighting: No controlled evidence identifies lighting as the primary cause; camera settings held in the displayed samples.
observations.population_budget: Many-body timeout is a hypothesis for photo WAIT, not simulated or established this round.

scope_correction: User explicitly requires actual photographed state as ground truth. All photos, including WAIT/NO RESULT, are tuning and failure samples. Do not require old algorithm success or substitute infrastructure diagnosis for threshold tuning.
